CardOmission.description:
Characters of the snapshot a card left out of the passage it quotes.

Offsets are character positions **into the snapshot's normalized text**, like the card's
`evidence_start_offset` and `evidence_end_offset`, half-open (`start_offset` inclusive,
`end_offset` exclusive). This is the opposite of :class:`CardSpan`, whose offsets index
`evidence_text`: an omission names text that is, by definition, not in `evidence_text`.

It holds no text. Whoever audits the card reads what was removed from the snapshot at these
offsets, and the exporter decides how to show the cut.

start_offset.description: Inclusive start offset of the omitted text in the snapshot.
start_offset.title: Start Offset

end_offset.description: Exclusive end offset of the omitted text in the snapshot.
end_offset.title: End Offset

CardOmission.title: CardOmission

CardSpan.description:
A marked region of a card's evidence.

Offsets are character positions **into the card's `evidence_text`**, half-open (`start`
inclusive, `end` exclusive) — not into the snapshot. The renderer marks up the quotation it is
given, so spans stay correct no matter where in the source the quotation was taken from.

start_offset.description: Inclusive start character offset into evidence_text.
start_offset.title: Start Offset

end_offset.description: Exclusive end character offset into evidence_text.
end_offset.title: End Offset

style.description: How the region is rendered: underlined or highlighted.

purpose.description: What argumentative work the region does, when known.

CardSpan.title: CardSpan

Citation.description:
The cite for one card, with per-field provenance.

`authors` is a single field holding the ordered author list rather than one field per author,
because a page's byline is harvested (and verified) as a unit.

Resolution — harvesting these values from a snapshot's HTML and from Crossref — is the
citation service's job (E06); this model only records the outcome and its provenance.

author_credentials.description: Author qualification as stated on the source or in Crossref/ORCID; never inferred.

accessed_at.description: When the platform retrieved the source.

authors_are_organizations.description: True when `authors` names the issuing organizations rather than people: the source named no person, and a typed source named the organization.
authors_are_organizations.title: Authors Are Organizations

cleared_by_student.description: Cite fields a student's last cite edit left empty, in cite order. Re-resolving the cite keeps each as the student left it; the edit policy rewrites the list on every cite edit.
cleared_by_student.title: Cleared By Student

Citation.title: Citation

CitationFieldSource.description:
Where one citation field's value was harvested from.

Recorded per field so an export can mark exactly which parts of a cite are unverified. A model
is never a source: authors, credentials, publications and dates are harvested deterministically
or left missing (architecture proposal §8).

Effort.description:
How much thinking and output a Claude model spends on a call: its quality lever.

Sent as Converse's `outputConfig.effort`. The current Claude models take no temperature but their
default and always think, so effort is the one knob that trades quality against tokens on them
(v1-e05-t01-model-router-port, Follow-up work). Unset sends none, and the model's own default
applies; that default differs by model, so a route that cares names a level.
Effort.title: Effort

Interpolation.description:
Words a debater added to a quotation, shown in square brackets and never part of it.

`anchor` is an offset **into the card's `evidence_text`**: the interpolation is read before the
character at that offset, or after the last character when it equals the text's length. `text`
is stored without brackets; :attr:`rendered` is the only place they are added.

anchor.description: Offset into evidence_text the interpolation is read before; len(evidence_text) means after the last character.
anchor.title: Anchor

text.description: The interpolated words, without brackets. The renderer adds them; a bracket inside is refused.
text.title: Text

Interpolation.title: Interpolation

ProvenanceMode.description:
Where a snapshot's or card's text came from.

This travels from the snapshot onto every card cut from it, so a reader can always tell
publisher-retrieved evidence from text a person supplied.
ProvenanceMode.title: ProvenanceMode

ResolvedRoute.description:
Where one call actually went, with the parameters it actually ran with.

Returned on every response (ac4), and the provenance a generated artifact keeps
(v1-e05-t04-prompt-registry). `temperature` and `max_tokens` are `None` when nothing was sent
and the model's own default applied; that is the normal case for the current Claude models,
which reject a non-default temperature.

task_class.description: The task class the call was routed as.

model_id.description: The provider's identifier of the foundation model.
model_id.title: Model Id

inference_profile.description: Inference profile the call was sent through, when the model is reached through one.
inference_profile.title: Inference Profile

region.description: Region the call was sent to; None for an offline router.
region.title: Region

temperature.description: Temperature sent with the call; None means none was sent.
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Output cap sent with the call.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit the call ran under.
timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds

effort.description: Effort level sent with the call; None means none was sent.

ResolvedRoute.title: ResolvedRoute

SourcedArtifactMetadata.description:
Provenance with the call's inputs recorded: the only metadata a generated artifact accepts.

:meth:`GeneratedArtifactMetadata.with_inputs` returns one. Its `snapshot_ids` and
`retrieval_ids` have no default, so a stored document without them does not load, and it is a
type of its own, so a field declared as it refuses the bare metadata a response carries.

prompt_id.title: Prompt Id

prompt_version.description: The exact version of that prompt.
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

route.description: The route the call took: model id, inference profile, region, and the temperature and other parameters actually sent.

provider_request_id.description: The provider's id for the request, when it gave one.
provider_request_id.title: Provider Request Id

TaskClass.description:
What kind of work a model call is, which is what routing is decided on.

Application code names a task class, never a model id. Routing a class to a model, a region
and an inference profile is configuration, so a Bedrock model upgrade is a change to the
routing files rather than to code across the platform (architecture proposal §10, ADR-0005).
TaskClass.title: TaskClass

VerificationStatus.description:
Whether a card's quoted evidence has been reproduced from its stored snapshot.

`VERIFIED` is set only by the evidence verifier (E03), only after the evidence text has been
reconstructed byte for byte from the recorded snapshot offsets. Anything else is `UNVERIFIED`
and must never be presented as a finished card.
VerificationStatus.title: VerificationStatus

description:
A piece of evidence cut from a source snapshot.

`evidence_text` is verbatim: it is the stored snapshot's text from `evidence_start_offset` to
`evidence_end_offset` with `omitted_ranges` taken out (see the module docstring), never written
or paraphrased by a model. A model may choose *which* span to cut and may write the `tag`, but
the quotation itself only ever comes out of the snapshot (architecture proposal §8).

`provenance_mode` has no default on purpose. Defaulting it would make
`PUBLISHER_RETRIEVED` — the strongest claim the platform can make about a piece of text — the
thing that happens when a caller says nothing, which is exactly backwards.

`verification_status` defaults to `UNVERIFIED`, and only the evidence verifier (E03) promotes
a card to `VERIFIED`.

created_at.description: When this record was first created, in UTC.
created_at.title: Created At

updated_at.description: When this record was last written, in UTC.
updated_at.title: Updated At

tag.title: Tag

evidence_start_offset.description: Inclusive start offset of the quotation's envelope in the normalized snapshot.
evidence_start_offset.title: Evidence Start Offset

evidence_end_offset.description: Exclusive end offset of the quotation's envelope in the normalized snapshot.
evidence_end_offset.title: Evidence End Offset

omitted_ranges.description: Snapshot ranges left out from inside the envelope, in canonical form: sorted, separated by at least one kept character, and touching neither end of the envelope.
omitted_ranges.title: Omitted Ranges

interpolations.description: Bracketed words a debater added, each anchored to an evidence_text offset, in strictly increasing anchor order. Never part of evidence_text, and not verified.
interpolations.title: Interpolations

normalized_text_hash.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot's normalized text the offsets refer to.
normalized_text_hash.title: Normalized Text Hash

normalizer_version.description: Normalizer version the offsets were taken under; needed to re-verify.
normalizer_version.title: Normalizer Version

spans.description: Underline and highlight regions within evidence_text.
spans.title: Spans

verification_status.description: Set to VERIFIED only by the evidence verifier, after reproducing the quotation.

provenance_mode.description: Where the evidence text came from.

format_profile.description: Name of the team's formatting profile for export.
format_profile.title: Format Profile

generated_by.title: Generated By
